title: END CARDS: HAUL STRIP IN ONE ROW, WHAT IS NEW CARD GETS AN X AND THREE SHORT NOTES
why: The critic scored 76 and 77 for ragged two row haul slots, and 40 for no X and five two line paragraphs.
now: The haul strip is one row of up to eight tiles with a count at its end. The what is new card has a lime tab, an X and Got it that both close it by click, and three short notes.
